entities.summary: Third Republic, a political institution in Philippines during Post-Independence and Marcos Era (1946–1965). Grew from Huk Rebellion — communist-led agrarian insurgency in Central Luzon. Led to the emergence of Bell Trade Act and Huk Rebellion.
